observation_schema.format: UTF-8 NDJSON, fixed key order, one record per line, final newline required
record_order: op sorted by SeqNum natural order
varnode in first post-emission op encounter order, then any remaining VarnodeBank location order
raw_edge in FlowInfo block_edge list order
observation_schema.op: Complete opcode, raw flags/additional flags, SeqNum address/time/order, post-emission Varnode identities, and parent block
observation_schema.varnode: Complete post-PcodeEmitFd storage, raw flags/additional flags, create index, merge group, def, ordered descendants, consume/NZ masks, type, High/Symbol/Cover presence, and identity
observation_schema.visited: Exact FlowInfo map key, instruction size, and first-op SeqNum address/time; VisitStat does not semantically carry mutable execution order
observation_schema.relative: Every Const-space BRANCH/CBRANCH with raw masked offset, wrapped computed time, and exact resolved target op or next-instruction address
observation_schema.cfg: Every raw PcodeOp edge pair plus every block's ordered ops, full incoming/outgoing lists, per-edge label/flags, reverse indices, block flags, ranges, entry status, and graph start block
observation_schema.post_emit_identity: Varnode IDs are assigned from actual Funcdata Varnode pointers after PcodeEmitFd::dump. Equal locations with distinct Varnodes remain distinct; repeated references to one Varnode reuse the ID.
observation_schema.abi_identity_exclusion: SLEIGH callback VarnodeData pointer identity is deliberately not observed or propagated. PcodeEmitFd allocates/canonicalizes Funcdata Varnodes; a Rust FFI pointer ID must never be mapped directly to Arc aliasing.
observation_schema.rust_snapshot: The Rust comparand consumes FlowInfoSnapshot after generateBlocks. The snapshot retains generation-time immutable op times, exact VisitStat values, relative-resolution results, and raw-edge Arc references; all Varnode IDs are assigned later from actual Funcdata bank Arcs.
observation_schema.space_id_normalization: LOAD/STORE input zero encodes an AddrSpace pointer in a Const Varnode. Normalize only that process pointer to target-space index/name/type/size and emit null offset/NZ mask; preserve its post-emission Varnode identity.
observation_schema.other_normalization: None; the image base is zero, so code and unique offsets are directly comparable.
